about_the_game:
The Badgers Pass series in a new dimension: The Western Branch!

Experience exciting rides on a combined rail network of over 74 km (46 miles) in length, covering 166 square kilometers (103 square miles) of wild mountain scenery.
Drive heavy freight trains for 41 km (25 mi) over the romantic Badgers Pass and over tough inclines down through the rugged gorges of Elk Canyon, over to Sequoia Valley with its mighty Sequoia redwood trees.
Take a transcontinental train (Badgers Zephyr) over 32 km (19 mi) from Badgers Burrow through the famous Skunk Canyon to Elk River and from there to Sequoia Falls.
Spectacular views of dizzying viaducts, rides through winding sparal and helical tunnels, and 
a challenging route that represents a feat of engineering.
Serve a complex network of diverse industries: 
For example, the timber industry in Frinton Valley, the wood processing and paper industry in Badgers Burrow, or take on the transportation of goods to many different customers in Frinton, Elk River, Wilmingtoin and Sequoia Falls.
In addition to four exciting new tasks, this route also brings new trains. New Superliner cars such as the dining car and the lounge car, including passengers, are included. And for even more realism, the trains make different squealing noises on curves, just like in real life.

Dare to take the adventure...!

Features:

- Complex mountain landscape ( 103 mi² scenery)
- Longest single route (Badgers Burrow - Frinton - Elk River - Wilmington - Sequoia Falls): 25 miles
- Connect 2 large, 2 medium-sized stations, 5 small stations, 8 industrial areas, various towns
- Realistic curve squeal sounds
- industry supply and demand chains
- 4 scenarios (2 with timetables)
- Trainz Living Railroads compatible (Trainz Plus only)

Trains Included:

- Amtrak P42DC Phase V
- Amtrak P42DC Phase VI 50 Years
- CPKC ES44AC
- SP AC4400CW
- UP AC4400CW
- CN ES44AC
- UP SW1500
- Superliner Coach, Coach Baggage, Diner & Lounge
- Viewliner Baggage
- Coach & Lounge passenger interior

Train Features:

- interactive couplers and cable
- Superliner brake lights
- dynamic fuel comsumption
- animated fans
- dynamic weathering
- weathering skins
- animated drivers cabin
- Deadman's control 

Search for 3DZug on the Trainz Wiki for more information on 'advanced features'.
